_doc: Follower joint offsets between calibrations, in degrees: offset = reading under the current calibration minus the reading under the calibration the data was recorded with, for the same physical pose. Rollout: act_rollout --joint-offset <name> (policy sees state - offset, actions are sent as action + offset). Datasets: subtract the offset from observation.state and action to bring new-calibration data into the old frame.

recal_2026-11-14.old_calibration: calibration/ as of commit cab4ab0 (used for duplo_teleop 0-516, duplo_pick, and every policy trained before 2026-11-14 01:00 XPS time)
recal_2026-11-14.new_calibration: calibration/ after the 2026-11-14 01:00 recalibration (wrist_roll and gripper horns reseated); used by duplo_teleop_cal2
recal_2026-11-14.evidence: pan/lift/elbow/wrist_flex: encoders read the same raw value at rest in both calibrations (mounting unchanged), so the offset is exact from homing_offset and range midpoints. wrist_roll: reseated, so taken from the pose at the inspection mark (fixed camera) in 517 old vs 100 new full demos: +1.1 (IQR 18), i.e. ~0. gripper: 5.7 when holding a brick at inspection in both.
